title.en: Context-Aware AI Essential for Enterprise Operations
title.zh: 上下文感知AI对企业运营至关重要

tl_dr.en: The article argues for the necessity of context-aware AI, highlighting that powerful models can fail in enterprise settings without understanding business operations.
tl_dr.zh: 该文章强调了上下文感知AI的必要性，指出强大的模型若不理解业务运作，可能在企业环境中失效。

en: Enterprise AI can generate recommendations, automate tasks, and accelerate decision-making processes.
Without understanding business operations, powerful AI models risk missing critical constraints and relationships.
Companies face the challenge of integrating AI from experimental stages into daily operational use.
zh: 企业级AI能够生成建议、自动化任务并加快决策过程。
缺乏对业务实际运作的理解，即使强大的AI模型也可能忽略关键约束和关系。
企业在将AI从实验阶段推向日常运营时面临挑战。

impact.en: This perspective underscores a fundamental hurdle for AI adoption in enterprise, moving beyond basic model capabilities to address real-world operational complexities. It suggests that AI's true value in business depends on its ability to integrate contextual understanding.
impact.zh: 这一观点强调了AI在企业中应用的一个根本性障碍，即从基础模型能力转向解决现实世界操作复杂性。它表明AI在商业中的真正价值取决于其整合上下文理解的能力。

title.en: AI Broadens Reach from Text Analysis to Autonomous Building
title.zh: 人工智能拓展范围，从文本分析至自主建筑

tl_dr.en: Recent research explores the application of language models in text classification, utilizing architectures like RNNs, CNNs, and Transformers, alongside investigations into large language models and reinforcement learning for autonomous construction.
tl_dr.zh: 近期研究探索了语言模型在文本分类中的应用，利用循环神经网络、卷积神经网络和Transformer等架构，同时也在自主施工领域研究大型语言模型和强化学习。

en: Language models are applied in text classification, encompassing architectures such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Transformers.
Hands-on experiments are conducted to evaluate the accuracy and efficiency of text classification models.
Large language models (LLMs) combined with reinforcement learning are being developed for autonomous construction and progress updates.
zh: 语言模型应用于文本分类，涵盖循环神经网络（RNNs）、卷积神经网络（CNNs）和Transformer等架构。
针对文本分类模型，正在进行准确性和效率的实际实验。
大型语言模型（LLMs）结合强化学习正在开发中，用于自主施工和进度更新。

impact.en: The continued development of machine learning algorithms, including language models, demonstrates their expanding utility across diverse domains. From advanced text classification techniques to novel applications in autonomous construction, these advancements aim to enhance efficiency and address complex challenges in various industries.
impact.zh: 机器学习算法，包括语言模型的持续发展，展现了其在不同领域不断扩大的应用价值。从先进的文本分类技术到自主施工中的新颖应用，这些进展旨在提高效率并解决各行业中的复杂挑战。

title.en: Google DeepMind, Singapore Government Partner on On-Device AI for Scam Detection
title.zh: 谷歌DeepMind与新加坡政府合作开发设备端AI诈骗检测

tl_dr.en: Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore collaborated to develop lightweight, on-device Gemma models for detecting conversational scams in private chats without cloud data transfer.
tl_dr.zh: 谷歌DeepMind与新加坡政府科技局合作开发了轻量级设备端Gemma模型，用于在私人聊天中检测对话式诈骗，且不产生云数据外泄。

en: The project utilizes lightweight, on-device Gemma AI models.
The models are designed to detect conversational scams within private chat environments.
The system operates with zero cloud data egress, ensuring user privacy.
zh: 该项目采用轻量级设备端Gemma AI模型。
模型旨在私人聊天环境中检测对话式诈骗。
系统运行不产生云数据外泄，确保用户隐私。

impact.en: This collaboration demonstrates a practical application of privacy-preserving, on-device AI in a sensitive security domain. It highlights the potential for AI models to address public safety challenges while adhering to strict data privacy requirements.
impact.zh: 此次合作展示了在敏感安全领域中隐私保护型设备端AI的实际应用。它突显了AI模型在遵守严格数据隐私要求的同时，解决公共安全挑战的潜力。
